Description: Validate unsupported options are hidden in RTMP mode
Step: Open the session in edit mode and select "RTMP direct streaming (entire screen)".
Expected Result: Welcome message, Enable Closed Captioning, Sharing settings, Only show participants names to hosts and speakers, and Allow hosts to create Breakout Rooms inputs are hidden or disabled.

Description: Confirm channel cannot open too early
Step: Attempt to click "Open Channel" more than 12 hours before the session start.
Expected Result: Control is disabled or blocked with a message preventing opening.

Description: Ensure channel opens once within 12-hour window
Step: When the start time is 11h 59m away (adjust start time if necessary)
column6: Open Channel button is enabled and populates Server URL and Stream key.

Expected Result: Value copies to clipboard; pasting shows the same Server URL.
Value copies to clipboard; pasting shows the same Stream key.

Description: Verify streaming app accepts RTMP credentials
Step: Enter the copied Server URL and Stream key into the external streaming application.
Expected Result: Streaming application accepts both values without validation errors.

Description: Check organizer sees live state when streaming begins
Step: Start the stream from the external application.
Expected Result: Organizer interface shows live status such as a live indicator or timer.

Description: Ensure attendees wait until stream starts
Step: Join the session as an attendee before the stream begins.
Expected Result: Attendee sees the waiting room until the stream starts.

Description: Confirm attendee player auto-loads live feed
column6: Video and audio play without needing a page refresh.

Description: Verify attendee can exit session gracefully
Step: As an attendee click the "Leave" control.
Expected Result: Attendee returns to the agenda lobby with no errors.

Step: Stop the stream from the organizer side.
Expected Result: Attendee receives the alert "This meeting has ended. You will be forwarded back to the lobby" with an OK option.

Description: Validate lobby redirect after stream ends
Expected Result: Attendee is redirected to the agenda lobby page.

Description: Ensure channel cannot reopen outside the permitted window
Expected Result: attempt to reopen when the session is more than 12 hours away.
column6: System blocks the action until the session is within 12 hours.

Description: Confirm copy actions handle browser permissions
Step: Trigger clipboard copy for Server URL and Stream key in a browser that prompts for permission.
Expected Result: Copy succeeds after granting permission or provides clear guidance if denied.

Description: Verify old keys become invalid after rotation
Step: Rotate the stream key and attempt to use the previous key in the streaming application.
Expected Result: Streaming application rejects the old key; new key works as expected.

Description: Check attendee experience when stream halts unexpectedly
Step: Stop the stream mid-session and restart it.
Expected Result: Attendee returns to waiting room during outage and resumes playback automatically when streaming restarts.

Description: Ensure organizer can restart streaming without page refresh
Expected Result: start a new stream without reloading the session editor.
column6: Organizer can start a new stream successfully and attendees see the resumed broadcast.
